result.title: Next-Gen Enterprise AI: Powered by Infosys & NVIDIA
result.description:
See how Infosys and NVIDIA are accelerating enterprise generative AI at scale. By combining Infosys Topaz with NVIDIA’s advanced technology, businesses can rapidly deploy secure, production-grade solutions. This video highlights how Infosys utilizes NVIDIA NIM microservices for high-performance inference, NVIDIA NeMo for custom model tuning, and NeMo Guardrails to enforce safety and compliance controls across the enterprise.

Infosys- https://www.infosys.com/
